name: Mohamed Osama
tagline: I design calm, tactile interfaces — then build them with clean, accessible React.
about: I'm a product designer and front-end engineer with eight years of experience turning fuzzy ideas into shipped software. My sweet spot is the overlap between visual craft and engineering: design systems, motion, and interfaces that feel alive without getting in the way.

Lately I've been exploring depth and translucency on the web — glass surfaces, layered light, and micro-interactions that make a screen feel physical. When I'm not pushing pixels, I'm trail running or perfecting a pour-over.

projects.title: Aperture
projects.description: A glass-forward analytics workspace that turns dense product data into calm, glanceable stories.

projects.title: Lumen
projects.description: A lighting-control companion app with spatial controls, ambient presets, and a tactile motion language.

projects.title: Field Notes
projects.description: An offline-first writing tool for researchers, built around a command palette and beautifully quiet typography.
